title: Condition colour stays visible on a highlighted row
note: Build with ETM-10043/10077. Nothing saved, Save never pressed, final reload: 0 error cells, Save disabled. Resource column sits under the Gantt: dragged the grid/Gantt splitter right to see it. Histogram collapsed except Delete Resource steps.

steps.do: In the Manpower Resource histogram right-click the resource of the task and choose `Delete Resource` (do not Save)
steps.expected: The resource cell of the task turns red
steps.why: Delete Resource on Crane Opt (confirm Delete + OK dialogs): task 8 (04-Test1) resource cell got b-invalid-cell, background rgb(255,204,199). Task 16 also red (also only Crane Opt).

steps.do: Record how the red cell looks with no highlight
steps.expected: The look of the red cell is written down for comparison
steps.why: Look noted: cell background rgb(255,204,199) (FFCCC7), solid, no highlight; row has only the blue selected tint.

steps.do: Right-click the row with the red cell, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFFB8F`
steps.why: Row cells measured rgb(255,251,143)=FFFB8F; the red cell stays rgb(255,204,199) and does NOT take the highlight colour (ETM-10043 fix: red now solid on top).

steps.expected: The red colour is still visible on the cell, shown with the highlight colour, and the cell is still recognised as red
steps.why: Red cell is clearly red (255,204,199) among yellow cells, so still recognised as red. But it is not shown WITH the highlight colour: it is plain red, no mix with FFFB8F (earlier build: orange mix). Person decides if this meets "shown with the highlight colour". Looked at the picture.

steps.do: Right-click the same row, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFCCC6`
steps.why: All 7 cells measured rgb(255,204,199) = FFCCC6 (swatch colour9).

steps.expected: The red colour is still visible on the cell
steps.why: Red cell rgb(255,204,199) is the same colour as the highlighted row (255,204,199): red cell cannot be told apart from the rest of the row (picture step-6). Red is "visible" only as it equals the highlight; likely fails the intent. Person decides.

steps.do: Right-click the row, open `Highlight Row` and choose `No Color`
steps.expected: The red cell looks as it did in step 2
steps.why: No Color: other cells rgb(255,255,255); red cell back to rgb(255,204,199), same as step 2.

steps.expected: The resource is back and the cell is shown with no error
steps.why: After reload without Save: Crane Opt[1] back on task 8, 0 error cells, Save disabled.

steps.do: Right-click the row of that task, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFFB8F`
steps.why: All 7 cells of row 8 measured rgb(255,251,143)=FFFB8F.

steps.do: In the Manpower Resource histogram right-click the resource and choose `Delete Resource` (do not Save)
steps.expected: The resource cell of the task turns red
steps.why: Delete Resource on highlighted row: resource cell b-invalid-cell rgb(255,204,199); other 6 cells stay FFFB8F.

steps.expected: The red colour is still visible on the cell and the rest of the row keeps `FFFB8F`
steps.why: Red cell rgb(255,204,199) clearly red next to FFFB8F cells; the other cells keep rgb(255,251,143). Looked at the picture.

steps.do: Right-click the row, open `Highlight Row` and choose `No Color`
steps.expected: The red cell stays red; the rest of the row returns to the default background
steps.why: Red cell stays rgb(255,204,199); other cells back to rgb(255,255,255).

steps.do: Right-click the row again, open `Highlight Row` and choose `FFFB8F`
steps.why: 6 cells measured rgb(255,251,143)=FFFB8F; red cell stays rgb(255,204,199).

steps.do: Make a dependency conflict on the row (no Dev steps yet: if there is no clear way on screen, stop here and mark `needs-human`)
steps.expected: The row gets the red border line
steps.why: No clear on-screen way to make a dependency conflict is given in the Test (no Dev steps); not attempted, as the Test says.

steps.do: Look at the row, then reload without Save
steps.expected: The red border line is still visible on the highlighted row, and the highlight `FFFB8F` is still visible
steps.why: Depends on step 14: no red border was made, so border + FFFB8F cannot be checked. Reloaded without Save: 0 error cells, no highlight, Save disabled.
